name: olef
description: Run, test and debug Android apps from Claude Code: works through the Olef CLI, and opens a live, interactive emulator/device viewer in the Claude Desktop browser pane when you want to see the app, with Apply Changes builds, annotations you leave on the device, recorded steps for tests, and a status line with the device and what each build did.

viewer.title: Device viewer
viewer.description: on-request (default): Claude works through the olef CLI and opens the live device viewer when you ask to see the device (or run /device show). always: Claude opens the viewer whenever it runs your app. Ignored when Olef's show_device setting is window (olef config init --user --show-device window), which uses the emulator's own window instead.

auto_approve_device_actions.title: Skip prompts for device actions
auto_approve_device_actions.description: Off (default): Claude Code asks before each device action, as for any tool. On: once you click "Let Claude use it" for a device in the viewer, Claude can tap, type, take screenshots and boot emulators there without asking each time, as with Claude Desktop's iOS Simulator. Building, open_url, installing an APK, the olef CLI tool and plan mode always follow your permission mode.
